# DataLoom Zrt. — Archive storage schedule

DataLoom Zrt. supplies managed archive storage for Project Atlas Archive. The agreement renews on 2027-04-30. Operations owns the intake procedure and Procurement maintains the commercial schedule. The service accepts signed document batches, preserves their retention attributes and supports a supervised restore to a temporary review folder.

Every delivery carries a batch manifest with a receipt number range and a page count. A batch is rejected when the manifest cannot be read or when an attachment is absent. The intake coordinator corrects the delivery package before resubmission. A rejected package remains in the quarantine area and is excluded from the accepted-volume figure on the monthly invoice.

The provider keeps an operational receipt for each accepted batch. A successful receipt confirms delivery to storage, while the department's inspection confirms that the pages and permissions are usable. Restores require a named requester and an agreed destination. The temporary destination is closed after the reviewer confirms that any required corrections have been recorded.

The planned rehearsal includes recovery of a bundle selected after the transfer has completed. Operations will compare page order, signatures and access restrictions. A difference in the restored page count requires investigation before the batch can be accepted. Scanning quality and paper preparation remain part of the local intake process rather than a storage capacity service.

The next quarterly review will compare rejected batches with the time spent preparing manifests. Procurement has asked the supplier to explain any fee for repeated delivery of the same corrected package. The agreement includes one supervised restore exercise per quarter. An additional exercise requires an estimate and a confirmed reviewer before the provider reserves a support slot.
